independent_units: eight previously frozen speakers; one source utterance each
source_combination: sum original credit and offered duration over both repeats inside each source and policy
primary_coverage: sum all original credited audio seconds / sum all offered audio seconds, including original EOS
primary_paired_estimand: 100 * (sum fullcall source credits / sum source offered - sum conservative source credits / sum source offered)
secondary_paired_estimand: mean of eight source-level percentage-point differences
resampling: eight source indices with replacement, using randrange(8); policies/repeats stay paired inside source
confidence_interval: 95 percent percentile; sorted bootstrap draws; linear interpolation at (n-1)*p for p=.025/.975
negative_effects: retained without clipping, removal, sign gate or favorable-estimand selection
latency_summary: median and minimum/maximum of original per-run unweighted linear P99 values, not pooled-frontier P99
energy: original a13 common both-board origin-to-confirmed-physical-model-drain windows; reference generation separate
quality: original final4f whitespace-only metrics, consistency checked across all four runs per source; unique source references counted once
actual_trace_refinement: separate original c4 closure required for final report PASS; pending allowed only with explicit pending report status
